{{Top|leg}}
'''Barimoq Crater''' was the ceremonial capital of [[Tasariq]]. It was connected to [[Tasariq City]] and [[Elikann Crater]] by an underground rapid-transit tube. The [[Imperial Ministry of Tourism]] listed it as one of the [[Wonders of the Galaxy/Legends|Wonders of the Galaxy]].
